transitions.name: Hard-cut flash

bloom.doc: exposure push on the image under the flash

transitions.use: Music hit, camera-capture moment, a hard visual comma; the frame is white ON the cut so the swap is invisible.
transitions.avoid: More than 3 full-frame flashes per second (photosensitivity); calm premium pieces; never on every cut.

transitions.name: Brand shutter (violet bars)

stagger.doc: delay spread across bars (fraction of each half)

vertical.doc: bars travel vertically instead of horizontally

edge.doc: highlight on the moving bar edge

transitions.use: Branded section change in launch films and ads; doubles as a chapter marker. Bars fully closed on the beat.
transitions.avoid: Short films and talking heads (too designed); more than once per 10 s.

transitions.name: Luma wipe (shape mattes)

angle.doc: degrees; direction of travel for linear/blinds

softness.doc: edge feather (fraction of the matte range)

edgeColor.doc: glow colour on the wipe edge

transitions.use: Graphic punctuation inside designed motion pieces; clock wipe for "time", radial for focus, noise for organic.
transitions.avoid: Overuse; reads dated unless the shape means something. Never in a short film scene change.

transitions.name: Iris (circle/diamond/star/rounded)

overscan.doc: final radius past the farthest corner

throughBlack.doc: classic cartoon iris: close on A to a colour, open on B

color.doc: fill colour for throughBlack, ring colour otherwise

ring.doc: ring width on the iris edge (fraction of height)

transitions.use: Reveal on a subject ("look closer"), cartoon/mime-style endings (throughBlack), playful product reveals.
transitions.avoid: Serious tone; centre that is not on the subject (it then reads as a template).

transitions.name: Whip pan (directional blur)

dir.doc: camera pan direction: [1,0] pans right (content moves left)

blurMax.doc: peak blur length, fraction of frame

transitions.use: Kinetic location or feature change; montage; alternate the direction on consecutive whips.
transitions.avoid: Serious or slow tone; more than 3 in a row in a premium piece. Match dir to the incoming action vector.

transitions.name: Zoom-through (radial blur)

center.doc: the aperture (screen, eye, doorway, letter O)

scaleIn.doc: incoming start scale (outExpo to 1); edges are mirrored

radialBlur.doc: radial blur strength at the cut

transitions.use: Travelling into something (a screen, an eye, a doorway); product-in-UI walkthroughs; "dive in".
transitions.avoid: Shots with no aperture/dark centre (it reads as a plain scale); calm pieces.

transitions.name: Match-cut helper (anchor solve + guides)

anchorA.doc: outgoing anchor [x, y, size (fraction of height), rot rad]

meet.doc: where the anchors meet on the cut frame

lead.doc: fraction of the pre-cut half that moves A

settle.doc: fraction of the post-cut half that settles B

guides.doc: draw alignment guides (A ring red, B ring cyan, meet crosshair): preview only

sfx.note: a sound bridge across the cut; no whoosh

transitions.use: Link two ideas by shape/position (wheel to clock, problem to product). The rhyme IS the meaning.
transitions.avoid: Accidental matches that say nothing; more than one per 15 s. Lint: matchDistance() > 0.5 needs this helper.

transitions.name: Morph cross-dissolve (luma-gradient warp)

warp.doc: displacement strength along the other shot's luma gradient

transitions.use: "This becomes that": logo to UI, product A to B, face to icon. Best on alpha-matted objects with shared silhouettes.
transitions.avoid: Objects with no shared silhouette (use maskReveal); fast edits (it needs 0.5 s+).

transitions.name: Light leak
transitions.use: Warm, nostalgic, lifestyle/brand and lyric edits; a glossy hide-the-cut.
transitions.avoid: Tech/clinical products and cold palettes (recolour c1..c3 to brand first).

transitions.name: Film burn

sfx.note: projector-snap role: the sound module ships it as tx/film_burn

transitions.use: Time passing, memory, "reel ends"; short films and music pieces; a retro hook.
transitions.avoid: Modern UI/SaaS demos unless the concept is retro.

transitions.name: Glitch (RGB split + slices)

rgbSplit.doc: channel offset at peak, fraction of width

transitions.use: Tech/cyber, "something broke", a pattern interrupt in hooks, comedic stutter.
transitions.avoid: Calm premium pieces; stacking on every cut (max 1 per 2 s).

transitions.name: Ink / liquid reveal
transitions.use: Organic, premium: beverage, beauty, ceramics; spill reveal of the next scene; artistic title reveals.
transitions.avoid: Hard-tech products; fast cuts (needs 0.7 s+).

transitions.name: Mask reveal by text

text.doc: the knockout word (JS only; drawn into the mask texture)

weight.doc: font weight of the mask text

fill.doc: text width as a fraction of frame width

hold.doc: fraction spent with the word as a window before the zoom

anchor.doc: zoom anchor inside a stroke; [-1,-1] = auto (thickest stroke near centre)

shadow.doc: drop shadow of the letters on A

transitions.use: Reveal the next shot through a word or logo: title card knockout; brand-word to scene. Very reliable in ads.
transitions.avoid: Thin fonts (the zoom anchor needs a thick stroke); long words at 9:16 (lower fill).

transitions.name: Push / slide

dir.doc: travel direction: [1,0] = B enters from the right

parallax.doc: 0 = classic push; >0 = A moves less and dims (slide-over)

shadow.doc: shadow cast by the leading edge of B

transitions.use: Next item in a list/carousel; feature to feature in UI demos; a "next" beat in explainers.
transitions.avoid: Story scene changes (it reads as UI); mixing directions within one sequence.

transitions.name: Swipe-up (social card)

radius.doc: card corner radius (fraction of height), squares off on landing

transitions.use: Native-feeling "next" in 9:16 feeds; story-style listicles; mime-style vertical spots.
transitions.avoid: 16:9 film (reads as an app); more than every 3 s.

transitions.name: Spin (rotational blur)
transitions.use: Beat edits and playful montages; "turning the tables" gags.
transitions.avoid: Premium/serious tone; consecutive spins in the same direction.

length.doc: max streak length, fraction of frame

transitions.name: Dip to black / white / brand

color.doc: dip colour; presets black / white / brand

transitions.use: Black: time/chapter break, end of act. White: memory, dream, heaven. Brand: end-card lead-in.

transitions.name: Cross-dissolve (linear / film / additive)

mode.doc: film = mix in linear light (no mid-dip)

transitions.use: Time passing (1 s), soft montage; additive for dreamy music pieces.

transitions.use: Soft hide of a cut inside UI demos and explainers; focus pull feel.

transitions.name: Scale punch cut
transitions.use: The cheapest energy cut: beat edits, ads, retention edits on a key claim.

transitions.name: Dither dissolve (accent pixel blocks)
transitions.credit: ordered (Bayer) dithering, B. E. Bayer (1973); GLSL and DOM written for this pack

cell.doc: block size in px at 1080p (scaled by height)

matrix.doc: ordered-dither matrix that sets the block order

color.doc: accent colour of a block in flight

band.doc: share of the window each block spends as an accent block
